metadata.title: Vibrant Expressionist Portrait with Dark Surrealism

retrievalProfile.description: A regal central figure in a fur-lined cape surrounded by surreal, macabre elements and saturated, bleeding color washes.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central, crowned figure with a weary expression, draped in a heavy fur-collared cape that flows into a group of smaller, surreal figures and skulls at the bottom, all set against a highly saturated, painterly background of red, orange, and purple.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure dominates the upper two-thirds of the frame
Cape acts as a vessel for secondary surreal characters
High-contrast color blocks separate the figure from the background
Visible, textured brushstrokes create a sense of movement and depth
coreInvariants: Saturated red and purple color palette
Regal crown with green gemstone accents
Surreal, distorted faces at the base

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure is large-scale, positioned in the upper center, looking slightly upward.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The face of the central figure and the bright green crown.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the crown down through the face, following the cape's flow to the smaller figures at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the background is filled with dense, bleeding color washes.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Saturated Red and Magenta (Background and Cape)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Teal and Mint Green (Crown and Fur Collar)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep Purple and Yellow (Shadows and Highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout with deep, dark values in the shadows to create dramatic contrast.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single minimalist serif to contrast with complex imagery.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic, legible serif that feels formal and understated.
Elegant old-style serif with light weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an oil painting of a regal man with dreadlocks wearing a crown and a fur-collared cape, with surreal skulls and children emerging from the bottom of the cape, set against a saturated red and purple watercolor wash.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of small, white serif text centered at the top of the image.

verificationChecks: Is the text small and centered at the top?
Is the color palette highly saturated?
Does the cape contain surreal elements?
Is the brushwork visible and expressive?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the background color bleed
Number of surreal figures at the bottom
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the central figure
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the crown has distinct green gems
Check that the fur collar has a minty/teal tint
Verify the background has a bleeding watercolor effect
Confirm the text is a light serif font
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a regal portrait with surrealist elements using a heavy oil-painting texture and a high-saturation color palette, topped with a minimalist serif disclaimer.
